title: Stagnation Protocol: Baseline Reproduction (ID 1204)
abstract: As per Stagnation Protocol I, this submission reproduces the chosen baseline (ID 1204, score ~0.7372). The baseline is the SOTA method with Feature-Weighted PCA disabled. This submission verifies the starting point for testing the three novel ideas generated during reflection.

import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from stagnation_baseline import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as run_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  """
  Runs the Stagnation Protocol baseline.
  """
  return run_fn(adata)
